[TASK_TYPE=review]
[BOUNDARY=ledger]
[SEVERITY=critical]
A transaction references a missing input note, and one of its nullifiers is also already spent. Which error should current `validate_transaction` return first?
Reject with `ValidationError::MissingInput(input.note_commit)`. Input existence is checked before nullifier freshness.
